# What is this building worth, and will the loan cover it?

> Free commercial real estate calculator: enter rent, vacancy and expenses to get NOI, property value at a cap rate, DSCR, cash-on-cash return, break-even occupancy and a cap-rate sensitivity grid. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
